def prose(text):
    for a,b in [('calendarQ','calendar Q'),('fiscalQ','fiscal Q'),('Q3DC','Q3 DC'),('Q4DC','Q4 DC'),('workbookSHA256','workbook SHA-256')]:
        text=text.replace(a,b)
    words='October|November|February|May|August|January|September|December|hold|Hold|own|versus|below|above|share|mix|split|concentration|base|street|required|cut|cuts|loss|losses|total|totals|cohort|outside|input|inputs|supplies|during|of|in|for|and|point|by|before|after|timing|allowance|approximately|compute|held|NVIDIA|AMD|TPU|AWS|Q3|Q4|Q2|Q1|against|all|another'
    text=re.sub(r'\b('+words+r')(?=\d)',r'\1 ',text)
    text=re.sub(r'\b(2026|2027)(?=[A-Za-z])',r'\1 ',text)
    return re.sub(r'\b(0\.5|1|2|3|4|5|8|13|14|16|17|19)(?=point|weeks|input|K\b)',r'\1 ',text)

def citation(source_id,quote):

    return {'source_id':source_id,'quote':quote}

finding='''Partly agree that current custom ramps constrain capture; additional calendar-Q4 displacement remains unestablished. February AWS disclosures show Trainium2/3 production and allocations during 2026, and April/July show ongoing custom growth, but units and mixed chips revenue do not identify incremental Q4 hardware dollars or replaced NVIDIA orders. Google external TPU sales began in Q2 with most recognition expected in 2027; they do not establish internal Google spending or zero 2026 external competition. Dated NVIDIA relationships with both customers support coexistence without proving order value/share. The unnamed channel custom signal mainly concerns 2027; the distinct dated deferral is already allowed for and cannot be recounted as substitution. Fresh SEC indices and reviewed later debt/director filings supply no new procurement dates; IR transcript retrieval was unsuccessful, so public timing detail remains incomplete. Compute-verified annual share stresses of 64.5%/64% give raw losses $2.86bn/$5.71bn at unchanged concentration. For cohort-only substitution, paired concentration 44.3593%/44.1673% preserves outside revenue and gives direct losses $1.27bn/$2.55bn, totals $370.16bn/$368.88bn and street deficits $5.84bn/$7.12bn. These are additional hypothetical net losses after the existing $3.19bn timing allowance, not adopted estimates. At equal Oct-Dec recognition and unchanged January, the one-point stress would reduce own Q3/Q4 to approximately $101.15bn/$125.30bn; month dates are not supplied. Hold all inputs and own Q4 $127bn versus required $126.58bn; current evidence was already considered in initiation/custom-risk adjustments, so another cut has no new probability basis. Named replacement orders, net invoice/control-transfer dollars and deduplication against the allowance would move the forecast.'''
